the screen: x 37, y 65, 117 × 147 px.

## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.3708 (spec 0.379), screen at the exact 176:220 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://i.blogs.es/9ea99d/f305_frontopen_polar_white/2560_3000.jpg (press render, Xataka Movil gallery; reflection cropped off)); geometry measured on a [photo](https://i.blogs.es/9ea99d/f305_frontopen_polar_white/2560_3000.jpg); specs: [teltarif.de](https://www.teltarif.de/h/sony-ericsson/f305/).
